_meta.what: Where a new business could work in Niagara Falls today, if anywhere.
_meta.rule: a newcomer, small (25th percentile) or typical (median) for its kind, sells at least 1.3x what existing businesses of the same kind, format and area (Tourist Core or the residential city) sell, in every scenario, and keeps a profit margin after rent on that street
_meta.caution: A single site's sales forecast can be off by up to about x3.6 either way (data/forecast_error.json); comparisons between spots and kinds are more reliable than the dollar figures.
_meta.zoning: City of Niagara Falls zoning by-laws (government data): 239 of 836 spots are outside a commercial zone (zone_ok false): they would need a rezoning or minor variance, unless a site-specific provision allows the use or the spot's point falls on the neighbouring lot.
